items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 November 2026 11:39am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure over northern Britain will decline, with a developing low moving into the northern North Sea tonight.


##Wind##

East or Northeast 3 or 4, backing North 4 or 5 later this afternoon and evening, then increasing mainly North 5 or 6 tonight, although staying 4 or 5 in east of area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 5 or 6, although 4 or 5 in east of area, decreasing generally 4 or 5 tomorrow evening. Backing and decreasing North or Northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair, scattered showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers later.
